text:
You need help sourcing products through Alibaba and managing the ordering, customs, and transportation steps smoothly.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, and data-driven workflow support. While my background is technical, I’m very comfortable with structured coordination, research, and handling complex process workflows with care and accuracy. I can help you organize supplier information, compare options, track orders, and keep the sourcing process moving clearly from purchase to delivery.

If helpful, I can also create a simple tracking process for suppliers, shipment status, and customs documentation so nothing gets missed.

What products are you looking to source, and which destination country will customs and transportation need to cover?
